component.name: Cassette Deck
component.summary: Photorealistic cassette player for local music

description.p: A 1980s portable cassette player for your own music, built as a native app for the COSMIC desktop. The deck is a real photograph. The reels spin, the keys press down, and every album is a cassette you pull off a shelf and drop into the deck.

ul.li: Spinning reels that turn like a real tape: one empties and speeds up as the other fills and slows
Click a cassette on the rack and its case swings open, the tape lifts out and slides into the deck
Eject and swap: press Stop twice and the tape pops out, and the next album's tape slides in when one ends
Keys that sink when pressed and spring back, and a printed label with the song and album
J-card: the album's songs typed out on old paper, split into Side A and Side B
Lyrics: a lyric sheet for the song that's playing, when its lyrics can be found
Cassette Rack: flip through your albums like a shelf of tapes, with their covers, from as many music folders as you like
Covers from your files, your album folders or the Cover Art Archive, with Change cover and Reset cover
Five deck colours, your own room backgrounds, and an optional album-cover wallpaper
Click the headphone plug to pull it out and mute the music
Tape sounds: keys click, the case snaps open, the tape clunks into place and fast-forward whirrs
Media keys and your desktop's player controls work
Picks up where you left off
Plays MP3, FLAC, M4A/AAC and WAV

screenshot.caption: The cassette deck playing a song

description.p: Click the headphone plug to pull it out and mute; the tape-eating close-up shows the same tape as the deck.
A Reset cover button puts an album's original cover back after Change cover.
The hidden extra is easier to set off by hand, and the close-up shows the tape's label.
A hidden extra: treat the wind keys roughly and the deck may eat your tape.
Lyrics: a lyric sheet for the song that is playing, from your files or from LRCLIB, shown only when the song has lyrics.
Lyrics: a lyric sheet for the song that is playing, from your files or from LRCLIB, shown only when the song has lyrics.
Several music folders and Rescan, albums grouped by Album Artist, multi-disc order, duplicate songs played once, keyboard keys on the Player, and buttons that no longer get cut off.
The J-card: the songs of each album on the printed insert from the case, split into side A and side B. Click a cassette on the rack to play it.

Album covers from your music folder and a Change cover button, safer cover lookups, new tape sounds, albums kept together when their tags differ slightly, and type a letter on the rack to jump to an artist.
Fixes a crash at startup on hybrid Intel and NVIDIA systems under Wayland.
Tape slides in and out of the deck, eject and album tape swap, moving keys and FUNCT switch, smoother backgrounds, Music Rack order and wrap-around fixes, and Space and S shortcuts.
Flatpak bundle now attached to releases
Header-bar window controls now render outside COSMIC. Packaging and documentation fixes.
